description: This file defines a PHP class 'CalendarViewGetGRUsers' extending 'SugarView' that handles retrieving user data based on request parameters, encoding it as JSON, and outputting JavaScript to update client-side variables. It is part of the SuiteCRM calendar module's view logic.

classes.name: CalendarViewGetGRUsers
classes.description: A SugarCRM/SuiteCRM view class for retrieving user information and generating JavaScript code to update client-side user arrays.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Handles the process request by calling display().

methods.name: display
methods.description: Retrieves user IDs from request, loads user beans, encodes data as JSON, and outputs JavaScript to set user array in client-side registry.
